findings.body: The verifier never checks `passed` for the required cases. A report with `m0-inert.passed = false` still passes as long as its `actual` fields satisfy the separate checks, despite the unit test and task contract requiring failed cases to be rejected. Validate `passed === true` for every required case before accepting the report.
findings.title: Reject required cases marked failed

overall_explanation: The evaluation verifier accepts required cases explicitly marked as failed. This contradicts its regression test and allows an incomplete or failed evaluation report to be certified as valid.
